title: agropyron intermedium var. microstachyum
intro: Agropyron intermedium var. microstachyum, commonly known as intermediate wheatgrass, is a perennial grass native to Europe, Asia, and North Africa. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of intermediate wheatgrass include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-cancer and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of intermediate wheatgrass also include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce stress, and promote wound healing.
